grammar.summary: 本课学习表「逃离」的 escape from 与表「典型」的 the average。

points.title: the average 表典型
points.explanation: the average man = 普通人。average 作形容词表「寻常的」，统计学隐喻。

examples.en: The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide.
examples.cn: 现代旅行者常常是不喜欢「辉煌酒店」的那类人。

points.title: 表「伴之以」的 accompanied by
points.explanation: He travels accompanied by a suitcase. 伴随的被动分词：accompanied by 固定搭配。

examples.en: He arrives accompanied by his own personal bed.
examples.cn: 他到达时带着自己专用的床铺。
